name: Voltaic Cyclosword
tooltip:
Galvanize
Damaging an Enemy Champions with an ability triggers Energized if it is ready.

Firmament
Your Energized Attack deals @PercentHPMeleeRangedSplit@% target's Current Health as bonus physical damage and grants you %i:scaleAPen% @LethalityBonusModMeleeRangedSplit@ Lethality for @LethalityBonusDuration@ seconds.

name: Bloodletter's Curse
tooltip:
Vile Decay
Dealing magic damage with abilities or passives to champions reduces their Magic Resist by @ShredPerStack*100@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds. (Stacks @MaxStacks@ times).

name: Abyssal Mask
tooltip:
Unmake
Nearby enemy champions take @DamageAmp*100@% more magic damage.

name: Atma's Reckoning
tooltip:
Big Hands
Gain %i:scaleCrit% @BonusCritPerHundred*100@% Critical Strike Chance per 100 bonus Health, up to %i:scaleCrit% @BonusCritCap*100@%.

name: Demon King's Crown
tooltip:
Supremacy
Increases your Health, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Attack Speed, and Ability Haste by @AmpBase*100@%, increased by @AmpGain*100@% per Takedown and @AmpPenality*100@% per Death.

name: Shield of Molten Stone
tooltip:
Immovable as the Earth
Increase your armor by @ARMod*100@%. Gain percentage Block Chance, scaling with your Armor up to a cap of @MaxBlock*100@%.

name: Cloak of Starry Night
tooltip:
Limitless as the Stars
Increase your Magic Resist by @MRMod*100@%. Reduce all damage you take from non-Basic Attack sources by a percentage, scaling with your Magic Resist up to a cap of @DRMax*100@%.

name: Sword of the Divine
tooltip:
Excoriate
Each Critical strike deals random bonus Critical Strike Damage, scaling up to @CritChanceToDamage*100@% of your Critical Strike Chance.

name: Veigar's Talisman of Ascension
tooltip:
Gain @EXPBonus*100@% Extra Experience

Offers no stats, and cannot be sold...

...But will be worth it if you reach Level 30.

name: Zephyr
tooltip:
Like the Wind
Gain @BonusMS*100@% Move Speed %i:OnHit% On-Hit for @Duration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxMS*100@% Move Speed.

name: Sword of Blossoming Dawn
tooltip:
Effervescence
Gain +%i:scaleAS% @ASPerHS@% Attack Speed for every %i:scaleHealShield% 1% Heal and Shield Power you have.

Peppermint
%i:OnHit% On-Hit, heal the lowest health ally champion near you for @TotalHealing@, prioritizing lower health allies.

name: Crown of the Shattered Queen
tooltip:
Safeguard
You are Safeguarded, reducing incoming champion damage by @ShieldDRPercentage*100@%. Safeguard persists for @ShieldLingerAfterInitiallyPopped@ seconds after taking champion damage. %i:cooldown% (@Cooldown@s).

Item Cooldown is restarted when damage is taken from champions.

name: Gambler's Blade
tooltip:
Playing for Time
Champion takedowns while using Gambler's Blade delays Doom-boss Veigar's arrival by an additional 10 seconds. Deaths while carrying the Blade accelerate it by 10 seconds. (Will not lose time past the 14:30 minute mark)

Double Down
Champion takedowns grant a stack, each granting 10 bonus gold on kill. Also take 5% increased damage per stack. Lose all stacks on death.

On Immobilize or Grounding an enemy champion, summon a comet above them. The comet lands after @DelayTime@ second, dealing additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage in the area. This effect has a @PerSpellLockout@s cooldown per target per spell cast.

Hack the Meat
Dealing damage shreds @Shred@ Armor and Magic Resist for @ShredStackTime@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times. Applying stacks has a @ShredInternalCD@ second cooldown per Ability.
